intl.title: St. Thomas University - International undergraduate admissions

cat.title: St. Thomas University Undergraduate Catalog 2025-2026 (admissions, tuition, housing)

test_policy.notes: Test optional; applicants may send SAT/ACT scores for course placement. Freshman minimum is a weighted 2.50 GPA (lower GPAs reviewed case by case) and 18 high school units.

requirements.notes: Free application at apply.stu.edu or the Common App. High school transcript (unofficial accepted for review) plus an official NACES or AICE credentials evaluation for non-U.S. schools. The I-20 is issued only after the enrollment deposit ($200 per the international page) with a Statement of Financial Sponsorship, passport page and bank affidavit covering at least one year's cost of attendance.

deadlines.label: Priority deadline, fall 2027 entry (rolling)
deadlines.notes: Catalog: applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; the application opens July 1; the fall priority deadline is May 1 and the spring one is December 1. Late applications face limits on scholarships, courses, orientation and housing. Dates print without a year (treated as fall 2027); no separate international deadline is published.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required of applicants from countries where English is not the primary language who have not attended a U.S., UK or Canadian school; the international page lists 44 exempt countries and territories. Any one of the listed tests satisfies it. No conditional admission or ESL pathway is described on the pages read.

english.notes: The international page prints 'TOEFL iBT 60 (0-120 scale) or 3 (1-6 scale)'.

B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency. TOEFL Essentials 6.0 and other tests (SAT, ACT 18 Reading, AP/IB English, GRE) are also accepted; the admissions page lists SAT 470 EBRW while the 2025-26 catalog lists SAT 960, so confirm the SAT figure.

cost.notes: 2025-26 catalog: full-time undergraduate flat tuition $17,277 per semester (12-18 credits), so $34,554 per year; the same rate is shown for 2026 programs. Fees, room and board vary by hall and meal plan (for example a double room $4,030-$4,150 per semester and a 14-meal plan $2,825 per semester), so a single room-and-board figure is left null. College Navigator 2024-25 lists food and housing of $13,210.

aid.notes: New international undergraduates get automatic GPA-based scholarships: up to $13,000 (GPA above 3.6), up to $11,000 (3.0-3.59), up to $9,000 (below 3.0). No separate application; STU says it does not offer 100% scholarships. Whether amounts are per year is not stated.

majors.notes: New students enter the Nursing Pathway, then need an STU GPA of 3.0+ after the BSN prerequisites and a passing TEAS score to enter the BSN. Direct entry to the BSN is for transfer students only.

sat.note: The pages read do not print a numeric SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: The pages read do not print a numeric ACT code; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed; results must be sent directly by the testing service.
